speaker: charlie
text: Now Jamie, forget the big league finals for a tick, because the real drama this week has been happening on suburban ovals right across the south east. Junior footy grand finals wrapped up over the weekend and mate, the sportsmanship on display was next level.

speaker: alice
text: I heard about that under twelves side that lost the decider but still lined up to guard-of-honour the winners off the ground. That is the kind of thing that makes you proud of grassroots sport, no egos, just kids loving the game.

speaker: charlie
text: Exactly, and every one of those clubs runs on volunteers, snag sizzles and parents washing muddy jumpers at midnight. Massive shout out to every coach and canteen legend who made this finals season happen.
